## Issue summary

Infrastructure, Docker, CI/CD and environment configuration for Infrastructure hardening.

**Project:** great-ptw-loto-ai-app
**Sprint:** SP-08.02 (Execution order: 14)
**Layer:** INF
**Priority:** Urgent (1)

## Positive test cases

- `docker compose up` starts all required services healthy
- CI pipeline runs lint, test, migrate and build
- Environment variables documented and validated at startup
- Redis/MinIO/Keycloak integrations reachable from API

## Negative test cases

- Service starts without health checks passing
- Secrets committed to repository
- CI passes without database migration verification
- Local and CI environments diverge silently

## Acceptance criteria

- Infrastructure changes merged with compose/CI updates
- Health endpoints green for dependent services
- Rollback path documented

## Definition of Done

- CI green on PR
- README/deployment docs updated
- No hardcoded credentials

---

## Existing notes

Infrastructure hardening for **SP-08.02 — Security & Performance Hardening**.

## Areas of work

* Redis caching strategy verification and tuning under load
* BullMQ background job throughput testing and queue tuning
* MinIO storage access-control and encryption review
* Keycloak security configuration hardening (token lifetimes, MFA options, session policies)
* Grafana Loki monitoring and alerting configuration for security and performance sign… (truncated, use `get_issue` for full description)
